artifacts.summary: Independent verification of all five extension-manifest quick-fix items, with the item-5 add-fragment-vs-delete-block judgment resolved per extension.

memory_candidates.content: extension-system.md's settings-fragment.json contract requires camelCase mcpServers at the top level; a manifest's own top-level mcp_servers field (any casing) is display-only and never consumed by the loader's merge_settings() -- it does a plain deep-merge with no key-name translation. When auditing extensions for MCP tool registration bugs, check both: (1) settings-fragment.json uses mcpServers not mcp_servers, and (2) every non-empty top-level manifest mcp_servers block has a matching merge_targets.settings entry -- four extensions (founder, filetypes, memory, present) were found with the latter gap and no automated check catches it.

task.md's keyword_overrides consumer (steps 4b/4e) requires {"<task_type>": {"keywords": [...], "aliases": [...]}} shape and pipes the jq call through 2>/dev/null, so a manifest using the wrong shape (flat string values) fails silently with no visible error -- the routing feature simply never matches for that extension. When reviewing new keyword_overrides entries, always test the jq pattern directly (not just visually inspect the JSON) since a shape error produces zero user-visible symptoms.
